description: Discrepancies and undocumented details in the cited Learn pages, SDK revision, and scoped live Azure recordings. This ledger does not certify Azuifer parity.

entries.summary: List XML ETags are unquoted; HTTP ETags use quotes.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: List Blobs gives an <Etag> placeholder without specifying quotation; Get Blob explicitly specifies quoted HTTP ETags for versions 2011-08-18 and later.
entries.observed_behavior: The live list_first and list_nested exchanges record etag=unquoted_match. Do not apply the HTTP quotation rule to the XML field.

evidence.detail: Response body (XML): <Etag>etag</Etag> does not specify quotation.
Response headers: HTTP ETag values are quoted from version 2011-08-18.
status=200; body.entries[0].etag=unquoted_match.

entries.summary: Both checksum headers produce the specific BothCrc64AndMd5RangeHeaderPresent error.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: Get Blob documents HTTP 400 when both checksum headers are supplied, but does not name the error code; the cited Blob error table also omits it.
entries.observed_behavior: HTTP 400 with BothCrc64AndMd5RangeHeaderPresent in the error header and XML body. The status agrees with the docs.

evidence.detail: x-ms-range-get-content-crc64 documents the both-headers HTTP 400 case.
The error table does not list BothCrc64AndMd5RangeHeaderPresent.
status=400; error_header and body.code=both_crc64_and_md5_range_header_present.

entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: The conditional-header page specifies HTTP 304 but not the x-ms-error-code header on that response.
entries.observed_behavior: HEAD and GET not-modified exchanges have status=304, error_header=condition_not_met, and an empty body.

evidence.detail: The read-condition tables specify 304 without the corresponding error header.
status=304; error_header=condition_not_met; body.kind=empty. get_not_modified and mixed_not_modified agree.

entries.operation: Create Hard Link / Create Symbolic Link
entries.summary: Learn lists x-ms-file-file-id; the Python SDK reads x-ms-file-id.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: The Learn response-header tables name x-ms-file-file-id.
entries.observed_behavior: The generated Python SDK deserializes x-ms-file-id for both operations. Live NFS behavior has not been established.

evidence.detail: Common response headers list x-ms-file-file-id.
Common response headers list x-ms-file-file-id.
create_symbolic_link and create_hard_link parse x-ms-file-id at lines 3664 and 3853.

entries.summary: The Read Symbolic Link page disagrees with itself about the first supported API version.
entries.observed_behavior: The x-ms-version request-header row says 2025-05-05 and later. The correct live boundary needs recording.

evidence.detail: Introduction specifies 2025-07-05.
Request-header table specifies 2025-05-05.

entries.summary: Successful Blob queries return HTTP 200, not 202.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: The Learn response section says a well-formed, authorized query returns 202 Accepted with an Avro body.
entries.observed_behavior: The CSV filter and JSON projection both return 200 with Content-Type avro/binary and no Content-Length. The media type agrees with Learn.

evidence.detail: Response status and headers specify 202 and avro/binary.
status=200, media=avro_binary, length_present=false. json_projection records the same wire fields.

entries.summary: A query with no matching rows still starts with an empty Avro resultData record.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: Learn shows the Avro record schema but does not specify the empty-result sequence or object-container block framing.
entries.observed_behavior: A no-match CSV query yields a zero-byte resultData record, then progress and end. The recorded stream has one record per Avro block and does not explicitly declare the null codec.

evidence.detail: Response body defines the Avro union without specifying what an empty result emits.
First record is data with bytes=0, followed by progress and end; block_sizes=[1,1,1] and explicit_null_codec=false.

entries.summary: Bad CSV casts produce nonfatal InvalidTypeConversion records at row byte offsets.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: Learn documents that Avro errors can be nonfatal and carry a blob offset; it does not identify this conversion failure's code or record sequence.
entries.observed_behavior: HTTP 200 carries an empty resultData record, three nonfatal InvalidTypeConversion errors at offsets 0, 7 and 14, then progress and end for the 20-byte input.

evidence.detail: The error record defines fatal, name, description and blob offset without naming InvalidTypeConversion.
Three error records have fatal=false, name=invalid_type_conversion, and description_matches=true for 'Invalid type conversion.'.

entries.summary: Invalid SQL can return an HTTP 400 XML error before the Avro stream opens.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: Learn describes errors encountered during response streaming, but does not specify the HTTP error for this invalid SQL expression.
entries.observed_behavior: Azure returns 400 ErrorProcessingQueryExpression, with the expression in the XML syntax-error message and request correlation. This is not an in-band row error.

evidence.detail: The status section describes well-formed requests and in-stream errors, not this syntax rejection.
status=400, media=xml, error_header=query_expression; body.message_matches and body.correlation confirm the syntax rejection.

entries.summary: An empty container-scoped Blob Batch returns outer 202 with an embedded 400.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: Learn says an empty batch fails with HTTP 400 and describes outer 202 for a well-formed, authorized batch.
entries.observed_behavior: The empty container-scoped request returns outer 202 with a single embedded 400 InvalidInput, no Content-ID, and correlated XML. A truncated part has the same response shape.

evidence.detail: Remarks list 400 for an empty batch without specifying an embedded response.
response.status=202 and response.body.status=400 with header_code=invalid_input and no Content-ID.
A truncated container-scoped part also returns outer 202 and one embedded 400 InvalidInput.

entries.summary: Mixed delete and tier subrequests return one embedded AllBatchSubRequestsShouldBeSameApi error.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: Learn requires homogeneous subrequests but does not specify the error code or where the failure appears for this container-scoped case.
entries.observed_behavior: Azure returns outer 202 with one embedded 400 and no Content-ID. The subsequent read finds the remaining blob unchanged.

evidence.detail: The request-body section requires all subrequests to be the same request type.
status=202; the sole part has status=400, error_header=mixed_batch_operations and no Content-ID. read_unaffected verifies state.

entries.summary: A P10 tier on a standard block blob returns InvalidHeaderValue with header details.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: Learn lists P10 for premium page blobs and a separate set of tiers for block blobs, but does not specify the response for using P10 on a standard block blob.
entries.observed_behavior: Azure returns 400 InvalidHeaderValue with HeaderName x-ms-access-tier and HeaderValue P10 in correlated XML. Cool tier, bytes, metadata and ETag are unchanged.

evidence.detail: The operation describes valid tiers by blob type but not this rejection payload.
status=400 and error_header=invalid_header_value; rejected_tier details verify both echoed fields.

entries.summary: List Queues includes an empty Metadata element when metadata was requested but none is stored.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: Learn makes Metadata conditional on include=metadata but does not show how an empty metadata map is represented.
entries.observed_behavior: With include=metadata on both pages, the first queue has populated Metadata and the second has an empty Metadata element rather than no element.

evidence.detail: Response body describes include=metadata and gives populated examples.
body.metadata=empty on the continued page; first_page records metadata=updated.

entries.operation: Create Table / Query Tables / Delete Table
entries.summary: Measured Table catalog errors do not include x-ms-error-code.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: The general Learn storage error page says failed operations from version 2017-07-29 onward also return the error code in the response header.
entries.observed_behavior: On these authenticated Table catalog errors the code is only in the negotiated OData JSON body. Neither x-ms-error-code nor DataServiceVersion is present. This does not describe entity or authorization errors.

evidence.detail: General error section says failed API operations also return the storage error code in x-ms-error-code starting in 2017-07-29.
status=409, media=json_no_metadata, error_header=missing and odata_version=missing; body.code=table_already_exists. Both observed missing-table errors also omit the headers.

entries.summary: Named Table catalog lookups and repeated deletes return ResourceNotFound.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: The Table-specific error list names TableNotFound at 404 but does not list ResourceNotFound; the Delete Table page does not specify this error code.
entries.observed_behavior: Reading the just-deleted table by name and repeating its deletion both return 404 ResourceNotFound in OData JSON.

evidence.detail: The error table lists TableNotFound but not ResourceNotFound.
The operation documents successful deletion and the name reuse delay without naming the repeated-delete error.
status=404 and body.code=resource_not_found after successful delete. repeat_delete records the same status, code and correlation.

entries.summary: If-None-Match: * on an existing copy destination returns 409, not 412.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: The Copy Blob header table describes the wildcard as create-only and says an unmet If-None-Match condition returns 412.
entries.observed_behavior: The same-account block blob copy returns 409 BlobAlreadyExists with correlated XML. The destination keeps its bytes, ETag and copy ID.

evidence.detail: The If-None-Match row covers the wildcard and lists 412 for an unmet condition.
request.if_none_match_star=matches, status=409, and error_header=blob_already_exists. read_unchanged_copy verifies the destination.

observations.summary: Echoed continuation markers are documented behavior, not an Azure discrepancy.
observations.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: The response-body section says Marker is present when specified on the request URI.
observations.observed_behavior: The live list_next exchange has echoed_marker=matches. The earlier omission was in Azuifer, not Learn.

evidence.detail: Response body (XML) explicitly describes Marker echo.
status=200; body.echoed_marker=matches.

observations.summary: The earlier Get Symbolic Link versus Read Symbolic Link claim is not substantiated by the cited Learn pages.
observations.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: An earlier note referred to Get Symbolic Link.
observations.observed_behavior: Both the operation index and reference page say Read Symbolic Link; the request is GET ?restype=symboliclink. A second authoritative naming source is still needed.

evidence.detail: The index names Read Symbolic Link.
The reference title also names Read Symbolic Link.

observations.summary: Acquiring with the current lease ID during a break returns the documented 409.
observations.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: The Lease Blob transition table specifies 409 for acquiring with the current ID while Breaking; the Blob error table names LeaseIsBreakingAndCannotBeAcquired.
observations.observed_behavior: Azure returns 409 LeaseIsBreakingAndCannotBeAcquired with correlated XML. After the break expires, acquisition succeeds.

evidence.detail: Transition table: Acquire (A) in Breaking (A) fails with 409.
Lists LeaseIsBreakingAndCannotBeAcquired with the same status and message.
status=409 and error_header=lease_breaking_no_acquire; read_broken_blob and reacquire_blob_lease confirm the later transition.
